This addition is compatible with the positive images rather than contradicting them, so it cannot serve as a hard negative.

This is a valid single predicate deletion—it removes one semantic constraint (eliminating the flare) while preserving the core column silhouette requirement. The resulting text is fluent and meaningful, and deleting this constraint produces a strictly weaker query that all positive images (which are column dresses with or without flare considerations) would satisfy.
